children: Manufacturing production in Hong Kong increased 2.3% year-on-year in the second quarter of 2026, down from 3.1% in the previous quarter and slowing for a second consecutive quarter to its weakest pace of growth since the second quarter of 2025.

Activity in the manufacturing of metal, computer, electronic and optical products, machinery and equipment slowed for a second consecutive quarter, rising 3.8% after a 6.5% increase, while output of food, beverages and tobacco plunged 4%, reversing a 2.2% rise in the prior quarter.
Meanwhile, production of textiles and wearing apparel remained in contraction, although the decline eased to 1.5% from 4.6%.
In contrast, manufacturing of paper products, printing and reproduction of recorded media rebounded, rising 2.8% after a 2.6% contraction.
On a seasonally adjusted quarterly basis, manufacturing production edged up 0.2%, following a 2.6% drop in the prior quarter.

title: Hong Kong Manufacturing Growth Slows Again
